releaseNotes:
1. Three-Level GIS Data Hierarchy: Upgraded architecture to 'Imported Files → Line Sections → Feeders'. Independent Line Section creation (+ New Section) with SQLite persistence, duplicate protection, and section management.
2. Feeder-Specific Display Colors: Unique display color assigned per feeder applied across tower markers, polylines (with high-contrast casing), right drawer indicator dot, and map legend.
3. Section & Feeder View/Hide: Toggling Section eye icon bulk-toggles all child feeders while preserving stored individual visibility; summary color dots in drawer.
4. Feeder Context Menu Refinement: Removed redundant 'Rename File (Parent Project)'; kept 'Rename Folder (Feeder)', 'Change Feeder Color', 'Duplicate Feeder', and 'Move to Another Section'.
5. UI Polish & High-Contrast Cursors: Set high-contrast cyan/teal cursor color across search and rename fields; updated Help author attribution to 'Er. D. SAKTHIVEL'; adjusted splash screen delay to 1.5 seconds.
6. Universal Multi-ABI Support: Bundled native binaries for armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, x86, and x86_64 ensuring seamless operation across physical devices and emulators.

previousStableRelease.releaseNotes:
1. External Google Maps Navigation from Marker Balloon Tip: Added small, prominent 'Navigate' button inside the compact tower marker balloon tip with Google Maps-style navigation icon; one-tap launches Google Maps app (or web browser fallback) with exact tower coordinates as destination in driving travel mode.
2. Marker Options Sheet & Popup Menu Integration: 'Navigate in Google Maps' also accessible via the balloon three-dot popup menu and Marker Options bottom sheet for comprehensive accessibility from both map and right feeder drawer.
3. Robust Coordinate Validation & Tap Debouncing: Coordinates are strictly validated (finite, valid lat/lng boundaries, non-zero) and protected with tap-debouncing cooldown to eliminate accidental double launches; alphanumeric Location Numbers (31A, 4T, 10/1T) preserved.
4. Real-Time OTA CDN Invalidation: Manifest checks updated with cache-busting headers and query parameters to guarantee instant OTA update detection on devices without CDN or proxy delays.
